duplicates_other.action: The revision merged C1122 into C1120.

duplicates_other.kind: Same passage, one record contains the other
duplicates_other.action: The revision retitled C0391 as the firstfruit permission ('Leaven and honey may be brought as firstfruits'). Its reference still includes Leviticus 2:11; narrowing it to 2:12 would finish the fix.

duplicates_other.kind: Same law recorded again in another passage
duplicates_other.action: C0129 (keep the Sabbath holy: Exodus 16:23, with 20:8) and AUD-02-31-13 (keep the Sabbath as a sign: Exodus 31:13–17) state the same keeping of the day. The revision keeps the holy-day command and the covenant sign apart on purpose, so this report does not count it. C0152 (the weekly work and rest) is a separate clause.
duplicates_other.origin: found in the 556 check; narrowed by the accuracy check

duplicates_other.kind: Same law recorded again in another passage
duplicates_other.action: Leviticus 19:13 (do not hold a worker's wages overnight) and Deuteronomy 24:14–15 (pay them before sunset) are the negative and positive forms of one duty. Maimonides counts both (N238 and P200), and the catalogue keeps positive and negative forms apart elsewhere, so this report does not count it.
duplicates_other.origin: found in the 556 check; reconsidered against the 613 matching

cross_references_now.note: C0733 (Leviticus 25:41) lists Leviticus 25:54 as Additional Scripture; the revision made 25:54 its own record for the foreign-master case.
C0212 (Exodus 22:29) lists Leviticus 22:27 as Additional Scripture; the revision also made 22:27 its own record for the eighth-day rule.
C0019 (Genesis 9:4) and TL-03-17-10 both list Leviticus 3:17, 7:26–27 and Deuteronomy 12:23–25, 15:23 as Additional Scripture.

labels_open.group: Clear correction
labels_open.title: The priest reexamines the skin lesion on the seventh day
labels_open.evidence: Standing step of the priest's scall examination, not a one-off direction; siblings C0486, C0488, C0489 are Mosaic Instruction.

labels_open.group: Clear correction
labels_open.title: Do not begrudge your gift to the needy
labels_open.evidence: Attitude prohibition, not a procedure; the matching 15:7-9 prohibitions C1037, C1038, C1040 are Torah Law. C1039/C1043 deserve the same review.

labels_open.group: Clear correction
labels_open.title: Do not resent releasing the Hebrew servant after the prescribed service
labels_open.evidence: Attitude rule within the servant-release law, not a procedure; sibling C1042 (do not send him away empty-handed) is Torah Law.

labels_open.group: Clear correction
labels_open.title: Israel: do not fear the enemy in the prescribed war with God's promised presence
labels_open.evidence: Generic 'when you go to war' charge, not one-off; the rest of Deut 20 has Mosaic types. Cf. C0959 (Torah Law); Mosaic Command possible.

labels_open.group: Positive duty under Instruction, negative twin under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Dispose of the torn flesh by giving it to dogs
labels_open.evidence: Twin C0214 (Torah Law): Ban on eating torn flesh and its disposal to dogs are one rule's two halves; disposal is no rite step, so Instruction is unexplained.

labels_open.group: Same ban under two labels
labels_open.title: Do not put oil on the jealousy offering
labels_open.evidence: C0418 (Leviticus 5:11, Torah Law) now forbids both oil and frankincense on the flour sin offering; C0800 states the same oil ban for the jealousy offering (Numbers 5:15) as Instruction.

labels_open.group: Same ban under two labels
labels_open.title: Do not put frankincense on the jealousy offering
labels_open.evidence: C0418 (Leviticus 5:11, Torah Law) now forbids both oil and frankincense on the flour sin offering; C0801 states the same frankincense ban for the jealousy offering (Numbers 5:15) as Instruction.

labels_open.group: Positive duty under Instruction, negative twin under Torah Law
labels_open.title: The man unclean through the stated nocturnal discharge: leave the military camp
labels_open.evidence: Twin C1151 (Torah Law): 'Go outside the camp' and 'do not enter it' are one exclusion's two forms; a purity rule, not a rite step, so the labels conflict.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Cover the hunted animal's blood with earth
labels_open.evidence: C0574 (Instruction) states it, but it is an everyday rule for every hunter, not a sanctuary or purification procedure.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Count the seven complete weeks and fifty days to the new grain offering
labels_open.evidence: Counting reads as a standing annual observance like festival rules labelled Torah Law; catalogue treats it as procedure (Deut 16:9 attached).

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Take the prescribed branches and fruit for Booths
labels_open.evidence: Annual observance binding all Israel, like dwelling in booths (C0704, Torah Law), yet labelled Instruction.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Count seven cycles of seven years for the Jubilee
labels_open.evidence: Count under Instruction while Jubilee rules (C0718, C0721-C0723) are Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Sound the Jubilee proclamation on the appointed Day of Atonement
labels_open.evidence: Jubilee shofar proclamation under Instruction while the Jubilee ordinance (C0718) is Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Have a non-sacrificial vowed animal valued by the priest
labels_open.evidence: Valuation itself is Instruction C0743; Torah Law C0744 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations (C0740, C0747) are Torah Law.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Have a consecrated house valued by the priest
labels_open.evidence: Valuation itself is Instruction C0745; Torah Law C0746 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations are Torah Law.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Aaron and sons: bless Israel with the appointed words and God's name
labels_open.evidence: The revision made the comparable standing priestly duties Torah Law: the lamps (C0284), the incense (C0337) and the daily offering (C0333). The priestly blessing is still Instruction.

labels_open.group: Standing observance under Instruction, comparable ones under Torah Law
labels_open.title: Administer judicial lashes under supervision in proportion to the offense
labels_open.evidence: Judicial penalty filed as Instruction; comparable penalty rules (C1182, C1089, C1193) are Torah Law.

labels_open.group: Conquest-era ban still a historical direction while its siblings are now Torah Law
labels_open.title: Do not spare the peoples placed under the stated conquest judgment
labels_open.suggest: Torah Law (as C0244, C0245, C0998 and AUD-05-20-17 now are)
labels_open.evidence: C0997 is a historical direction, though AUD-05-20-17 labels the same devotion judgment (20:17-18) Torah Law.

labels_open.group: Conquest-era ban still a historical direction while its siblings are now Torah Law
labels_open.title: Carry out the prescribed judgment against Amalek after the stated rest
labels_open.suggest: Torah Law (as C0244, C0245, C0998 and AUD-05-20-17 now are)
labels_open.evidence: Standing judgment filed as historical direction while the parallel seven-nations judgment AUD-05-20-17 is Torah Law; arguably a one-time charge.

labels_open.group: Standing duty still under Mosaic Command
labels_open.title: Reprove your neighbour
labels_open.evidence: Only C0616 (Mosaic Command) itemizes it, though the same verse's prohibitions are Torah Law; it reads as a standing duty.

labels_open.group: Standing duty still under Mosaic Command
labels_open.title: Revere God's sanctuary and holy things
labels_open.evidence: Only C0636 (Mosaic Command) itemizes it, while 'revere father and mother' (C0595) is Torah Law; it reads as a standing rule.

labels_open.group: Standing duty still under Mosaic Command
labels_open.title: Rise before the aged
labels_open.evidence: Only Mosaic Command records C0639 and C0640 itemize it; a standing conduct rule like Torah Law C0595 (revere parents).

labels_open.group: Standing duty still under Mosaic Command
labels_open.title: Honour the elder
labels_open.evidence: Only Mosaic Command records C0639 and C0640 itemize it; a standing conduct rule like Torah Law C0595 (revere parents).

labels_open.group: Standing duty still under Mosaic Command
labels_open.title: Levites: carry the tabernacle and its furnishings in their assigned service
labels_open.evidence: Only Command C0768 and Commission AUD-05-10-8; Torah Law C0840 covers service ages only; the 18:23 clause has no record.

labels_open.group: Standing duty still under Mosaic Command
labels_open.title: Levites: guard the tabernacle and its furnishings
labels_open.evidence: Guard duty only as Command C0772 (Num 1:53; 3:7-8); C0874 holds 18:4 but states the outsider ban (N74).

labels_open.group: Standing duty still under Mosaic Command
labels_open.title: Aaron and sons: keep the priestly charge of altar and inner sanctuary
labels_open.evidence: Only positive Command charges (C0774 holds 18:5; C0772 Levite guard); Maimonides reads 'keep the charge' as forbidding an unguarded sanctuary.

labels_open.group: New: same practice under two labels
labels_open.title: Drain the blood of animals killed for food, as prescribed
labels_open.evidence: The new TL-05-12-16 ('pour the blood onto the ground', Deuteronomy 12:16, 24) is Torah Law; C0573 states the same draining of blood in Leviticus 17:13 as Instruction.
